newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain to liberalise telecoms market on Dec 1, 1998.
newsitem.headline: Spain to liberalise telecoms market on Dec 1, 1998.

text.p: Spain will liberalise its telecommunications market on December 1, 1998, according to a statement issued on Monday by Development Minister Rafael Arias Salgado.

The minister said he felt obliged to make a statement to clear up confusion caused by his comments on the decision by Brussels to authorise a union between Spain's Telefonica and the Unisource consortium.
"The government will fulfill the agreement in all its points and complete liberalisation will be effective on December 1, 1998."
In the statement, Salgado said licences would be awarded in 1998 under the agreement while requests presented after December 1, 1998 would be dealt with according to European Union rules.
On Saturday, the European Commission approved the integration of Telefonica in Unisource after Spain promised to liberalise its telecommunications market.
